scope: New retarget wrappers only; no existing helper, comparator, test, production source, or build file edited.

cause_corrections.cause: The reference build runner assumes its ROOT-to-REPO depth and hardcoded reference source pins.
cause_corrections.correction: Generated step-local build.py keeps ROOT at step_dir, substitutes REPO through an asserted exact anchor, refreshes only adaptation/helper/build metadata pins, and fails on source drift outside that scope.

cause_corrections.cause: run_cases accepts only buildN labels, while cut wrappers initially accepted arbitrary tokens.
cause_corrections.correction: Require unique build[1-9][0-9]* labels and refuse labels already used by staged receipts.

cause_corrections.cause: The reused unit helper writes G3 integer-row output at N4 root and uses fixed case prefixes.
cause_corrections.correction: Assert and retarget its G3 row artifact to the step directory and make F3b-generated case prefixes build-label-specific; preserve the original helper __file__ for import roots.

cause_corrections.cause: The generic cheap BL gate permits further edits after the shared first 336 and only requires a minimum split count.
cause_corrections.correction: Post-compare all integer output rows against the fresh N4 G3 reference, require 473 actual splits/edits, preserve first-336 P6c pass, and require exact equality of saved-state output SHA maps.

cause_corrections.cause: Prefix checks could silently compare a candidate without the captured N4 baseline.
cause_corrections.correction: G2/GQ/G3 candidate actions require --reference-case; prefix controller is imported with step binary/build/pin overrides while PURPOSE remains N4.

cause_corrections.cause: The build recipe assertion expected whitespace absent in the copied reference argv.
cause_corrections.correction: Matched the source’s compact literal `nice`,`-n`,`19` argv form; retarget-builder self-check then passed.

cause_corrections.cause: F3b unit-helper execution injected CUT_HELPER into a string evaluated inside the helper, whose inner exec namespace did not define it.
cause_corrections.correction: Removed the injected reference; the wrapper is already covered by the new build source pin set, and the inner namespace now contains only its actual required REF_DIR binding.

cause_corrections.cause: The reusable full-workflow validator checked physical, transfer, timer, and resource gates but did not compare all six event payload hashes with accepted P6c outputs.
cause_corrections.correction: Added G5, which runs the existing full controller unchanged and then compares all six mesh, native reference, and restart hashes against the accepted P6c completion/full-workflow receipts. It requires both receipts to be accepted, both timer events to be covered, and the payload identity records to agree.

cause_corrections.cause: G3 trusted the candidate receipt's three saved-state SHA claims without rehashing the current files.
cause_corrections.correction: G3 now hashes each of the three candidate payload files (and the reference payload files), checks path containment, and requires the actual hashes to match their receipt maps before accepting equality.

g5_workflow_gate_reuse.timer_six_rank_coverage: existing assess_event loop requires event 1 and 2 receipts
g5_workflow_gate_reuse.resource: existing per-process sampled peak HWM <= 19,999,490,048 bytes and final reported rank-peak sum <= 20,000,000,000 bytes per event
g5_workflow_gate_reuse.payload_identity: new wrapper requires exact six output hashes to match accepted P6c receipts

g3_reference.comparison: all integer rows plus exact saved-state payload SHA map

g5_api.mode: full workflow; execute only when parent authorizes after other gates
